LESSON: WRITING POSTURE

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.3: Writing Posture

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing Posture. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate book when writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Sit appropriately when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate scribbling, drawing or writing in class.
2. Enjoy participating in activities for writing • In pairs and groups learners could practise the posture in and out of class. practise it. drawing and be encouraged to use the appropriate writing posture.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Sit appropriately when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate scribbling, drawing or writing in class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sit appropriately when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate scribbling, drawing or writing in class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Enjoy participating in activities for writing • In pairs and groups learners could practise the posture in and out of class. practise it. drawing and be encouraged to use the appropriate writing posture.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy participating in activities for writing • In pairs and groups learners could practise the posture in and out of class. practise it. drawing and be encouraged to use the appropriate writing posture. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing Posture.
2. Explain Writing Posture to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Writing Posture.
4. Show that you can: Sit appropriately when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate scribbling, drawing or writing in class.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing Posture. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate book when writing?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Sit appropriately when • Learners could recite rhymes on the appropriate scribbling, drawing or writing in class.
2. Enjoy participating in activities for writing • In pairs and groups learners could practise the posture in and out of class. practise it. drawing and be encouraged to use the appropriate writing posture.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
